newsitem.title: USA: OfficeMax Q4 sales up 17 pct to $966.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: OfficeMax Q4 sales up 17 pct to $966.8 mln.

text.p: OfficeMax Inc said its fourth-quarter sales increased 17 percent to $966.8 million from $823.2 million.
The company did not say how the increased sales would affect earnings for the quarter or full year. For fiscal 1996, the company said its sales rose 25 percent to $3.179 billion from $2.543 billion.
The company said it will release the earnings on or before March 7.
Officials at OfficeMax were not immediately available.
The company also said that its same-store sales for the quarter rose eight percent.
